name: Coastal Roadways Limited
summary: Coastal Roadways Ltd. is a specialist provider of diverse logistics and transportation services. Their extensive offerings include comprehensive supply chain management, full and partial truckload shipping, containerized vehicle operations, handling of over-dimensional cargo, warehousing facilities, multimodal transport options, and integrated end-to-end solutions. Madan Gopal Todi founded the company on September 18, 1968, and it maintains its headquarters in Kolkata, India.
